$comment: Constructor-bar floor (YOY-118 AC-3). overallHitRatePercent: the overall hit rate the harness achieved on the committed recordings, rounded down. mustNotViolationsMax / mustNotCleanRatePercent: the measured mustNot leak. YOY-133 (2026-08-27/28) made negated attributes hard exclusions, the bridal form a category-like inclusion, and purpose phrases ("sneakers for running") a deterministic AI route: 19 / 66 → 0 / 100. Every value records what the engine does today (NG-2): tighten only from a measured run, never loosen to absorb a regression.

v2.$comment: Engine v2 floor (YOY-153 AC-3), measured 2026-10-04 by constructor-v2.test.ts on the committed v2 recordings (cards, wish extraction, Jev judge): per group, the hit rate (an expected product in the top 10), rounded down, and the measured top-10 mustNot leak. On v2 a forbidden product is not removed by a price cap or an occasion — the judge ranks it after the matches as close or not relevant — so the price-cap and occasion groups show it lower in the top 10 (8 and 12 appearances), never leading; negations are removed (0). Same rule as the old engine's fields above: tighten only from a measured run, never loosen to absorb a regression.
